I like teaching through systems I have actually built. My sessions tend to combine a working implementation, the evaluation loop around it, and the mistakes that shaped the final approach. My longer-form courses are documented on the [Work page](work.qmd#courses).

## Selected talks and workshops

::: {.talk}
<div class="item-meta">2025<br>W&B webinar</div>
<div class="item-body"><strong>[Agent evaluations with CrewAI and W&B Weave](https://wandb.ai/site/resources/events/agent-evals-with-crewai-wb-weave/)</strong><br>With Tony Kipkemboi and João Moura. A practical blueprint for tracing, evaluating, and iterating on agentic applications.</div>
:::

::: {.talk}
<div class="item-meta">2025<br>DataHack Summit</div>

## Community

I was a **Google Developer Expert in Machine Learning** from 2022 to 2025. I have also taught through GDG communities, Kaggle, W&B events, and local ML groups. This page is a curated record rather than a complete calendar; I will keep adding older sessions as recordings and event pages resurface.

For a session, workshop, or collaboration, the best way to reach me is [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/ayush-thakur-731914149/).
